steps.title: Какой союз показывает, что всё уже было закончено?
steps.why: После by the time во второй части обычно стоит Past Perfect.

steps.title: Пять союзов — пять функций
steps.html:
СоюзЧто показываетПример
whenодно событие в момент другогоWhen the boy was not found, a search started.
whileдлительное действие вокруг негоWhile reporters were interviewing the family, the boy spoke.
as soon asсразу послеAs soon as it was high in the sky, they made the claim.
by the timeне позже этого момента — уже до негоBy the time the balloon landed, the story was on television.
untilдо этого момента, потом прекращаетсяMost scientists accepted it until the fake was discovered.

steps.title: Два союза, которые путают
steps.html:
while — с длительным действием: While he was looking for the path… when — с коротким: When the door opened…

until отвечает на как долго? — They waited until midnight. by the time — на что уже произошло к этому моменту?

После всех пяти союзов — прошедшее время, не will, не would и не Present Perfect.

steps.answer: Что-то звучит так хорошо, что, скорее всего, неправда

steps.title: Too good to be true
steps.html:
Прочитайте один раз, чтобы уловить три истории. Не останавливайтесь на каждом слове.

Every hoax needs two things: a story people want to believe, and a gap before anyone checks it. The internet has made the first easy and the second short. A photograph can be changed in a minute, and by the time an editor asks where it came from, the picture has already travelled round the world.

Take the blue watermelon. A bright blue fruit appeared online with a confident caption: it grew on the slopes of a volcano, it cost two hundred dollars, and it made everything you ate afterwards taste sour. As soon as the picture began to circulate, garden websites started selling the seeds. A national newspaper reported the story as fact. Nobody had invented a new fruit; somebody had simply changed the colour of an ordinary watermelon.

Some hoaxes cost more than embarrassment. In 2009 a family in Colorado let a large silver balloon float into the sky and announced that their six-year-old son was inside it. The police were informed, helicopters tracked the balloon, and the story was live on television until it landed, eighty kilometres away, empty. While reporters were interviewing the family, the boy mentioned that they had done it to be on TV. He was supposed to keep quiet.

And some hoaxes are believed for a lifetime. When Dawson and Woodward announced in 1912 that they had found a skull with an ape-like jaw, scientists accepted the conclusion: here at last was the evidence linking early man and apes. Nobody proved it was a fake until nearly forty years later. By the time the truth came out, forty years of work had been wasted, and Dawson, whom most people now consider responsible, was dead.

What the three stories share is not technology. It is the moment when someone decides that a story is too good to check.

Some hoaxes cost more than embarrassment. In 2009 a family in Colorado let a large silver balloon float into the sky and announced that their six-year-old son was inside it. The police were informed, helicopters tracked the balloon, and the story was live on television until it landed, eighty kilometres away, empty. While reporters were interviewing the family, the boy mentioned that they had done it to be on TV. He was supposed to keep quiet.

And some hoaxes are believed for a lifetime. When Dawson and Woodward announced in 1912 that they had found a skull with an ape-like jaw, scientists accepted the conclusion: here at last was the evidence linking early man and apes. Nobody proved it was a fake until nearly forty years later. By the time the truth came out, forty years of work had been wasted, and Dawson, whom most people now consider responsible, was dead.

What the three stories share is not technology. It is the moment when someone decides that a story is too good to check.

steps.title: Перескажите одну из трёх историй вслух.
items: Выберите синий арбуз, шар или череп.
Расскажите пятью предложениями. Используйте минимум три союза.
Закончите на It turned out that… или In the end…

steps.title: Расскажите историю, в которую вы поверили, а потом узнали, что это неправда. Запишите себя.
steps.sub: Используйте минимум три союза и одно комментирующее наречие.
items: I read / heard that … . At first I believed it because …
As soon as … / While … / By the time …
It turned out that … . Surprisingly, / Personally, …

steps.title: Урок 5 пройден
items: Я выстраиваю события с when, while, as soon as, by the time, until.
Я сохраняю правильные прошедшие формы внутри последовательности.
Я могу говорить о новостях, доказательствах и доверии.
Я слежу за последовательностью событий в статье.
